page.content:
Manual drip through a cone — Chemex, V60, and the third-wave ritual.

How Pour-over connects

  • Ship: Chemex — The Chemex is a classic pour-over brewer.
  • Topic: Third wave coffee — Pour-over is a ritual brew method of the third wave.

What is Pour-over?

Pour-over brewing made the kettle and paper filter a performance: control of flow as a way to taste origin, not just strength.

Key threads lead to Chemex and Third wave coffee.
